limit.title: Max Markets to Scan
limit.description: Maximum number of active Polymarket events to retrieve and analyze.

minVolumeUsd.title: Minimum Volume ($)
minVolumeUsd.description: Filter out low-volume markets. Only return markets with trading volume above this threshold.

detectArbitrage.title: Detect Implied Probability Arbitrage
detectArbitrage.description: Flag markets where total outcome token pricing deviates from 1.00 by more than 1.5%.

tagFilter.title: Tag / Category Filter
tagFilter.description: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Politics', 'Crypto', 'Fed', 'Tech'). Leave blank for all.
